analysis.title: GS Jee - GS KOREA FINAL RECLAIMS ITS 5,000 HANDLE 24 Nov 2026
key_insights: KOSPI rose 6.32% to 5006.0, reclaiming the 5,000 handle after three sessions and posting its largest single-day gain since Oct 28, 2026.
Short covering likely added to momentum, with the GS Korea top pair-dealing basket (GSKRTPDT) up 5.4%.
AI supply chain led gains: KRXSEMI +6.8% and KOSPELEC +7.1%, helped by SOX +14% and NVDA's rally after Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO.
Foreigners turned net buyers in KOSPI (+US$540mn) after seven straight days of net selling, with Samsung Electronics (SEC) buying of +$314mn the focus.
Local institutions net bought (+US$647mn), led by pension and local broker prop inflows, while retail was the sole net seller (-US$1,520mn in KOSPI).
KOSPI turnover was subdued at US$10.8bn, -5.5% vs the 20D average. Early chasing in memory faded into the afternoon.
Semis: SEC +6.7% and SK Hynix +6.7%. Foreign flows diverged, with SEC net bought +$314mn and Hynix net sold -$101mn. Other corporates (+$310mn) were the sole net buyers in Hynix.
Robotics rallied: Rainbow Robotics +17.4%, Doosan Robotics +11.3%, Robotis +19.5%. SEC is set to unveil its first in-house humanoid robot at CES 2027.
EV supply chain (GSXAKREV) rose 10.2% after a local broker upgraded the sector from Neutral in 2H26 to Overweight for 2027 on expected earnings recovery and ESS ramp-up.
KOSDAQ rose 4.79% to 665.9 on US$4.0bn turnover. Foreigners bought +$88mn, locals +$154mn, and retail sold -$230mn.

market_movers.rationale: Samsung Electronics rose 6.7% with foreign net buying of +$314mn. It plans to unveil its first in-house humanoid robot at CES 2027.
SK Hynix rose 6.7% on the SOX rally, though foreigners net sold -$101mn and local institutions and retail took profits.
NVDA rallied 31% after Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO, lifting SOX +14% and Asian risk appetite.
A local broker upgraded the Korea EV supply chain from Neutral in 2H26 to Overweight for 2027 on an earnings recovery and ESS ramp-up. GSXAKREV rose 10.2%.

sector_views.rationale: A local broker expects an earnings recovery on easing EV demand pressure and ESS ramp-up, with policy support in the US, Europe and Korea.
The AI supply chain led the rally, with KRXSEMI +6.8% and SOX +14%.
Robotics names rose 11% to 20% on Samsung's humanoid robot plans.

macro_indicators.interpretation: KRW depreciated 15 bps despite the equity rally and foreign buying.

risk_factors: Subdued turnover suggests the rally lacked broad participation.
Foreign flows diverged between SEC (buying) and Hynix (selling).
The rally depends on the NVDA and SOX move following Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO.
Activity faded into the afternoon despite market resilience.
vol_and_positioning: Short covering likely contributed to the rally, with GSKRTPDT +5.4%.
Foreigners ended a seven-day net selling streak in KOSPI.
Retail was the sole net seller in both KOSPI (-US$1,520mn) and KOSDAQ (-US$230mn).
KOSPI turnover was -5.5% vs the 20D average, showing limited conviction.
